pairs.subject: design-tokens
pairs.evidence: src/components/ui/Kicker.tsx:21 These primitives mix semantic roles with direct palette references, untokenized motion, and theme-specific overrides, preventing visual decisions from consistently flowing through shared roles.

techniques.evidence: src/components/ui/format.ts:39 Stat consumes this fixed hex mapping; flat remains #94a3b8 while theme-prism.css:22 rebinds --color-tone-flat to #b7bbcc, and format.test.ts:56-59 checks only globals.css.

src/components/ui/Stat.tsx:54 These are author-selected presentation variants; searches for density, text-scale, font-scale, prefers-contrast, and brightness found no user appearance axis in the listed context.
src/app/globals.css:691 Reveal's .js-reveal rule embeds a duration and easing curve instead of consuming a named motion ladder; reduced motion is handled by a selector-specific media block.
src/app/kit.css:387 HairlineGrid receives a component-specific theme override, including a raw radius, instead of consuming roles whose bindings change at the scope root.

src/components/deck/DeckNav.tsx:65 Deck navigation directly consumes palette primitives without a loud suppression; the inspected enforcement configuration provides no rule or ratchet rejecting these references.
src/components/ui/Kicker.tsx:22 Kicker composes arbitrary tracking beside its text role, while its muted tone directly selects slate-500 rather than a semantic foreground role.
